definition.authority_set: 3 alternating A/B pairs = 6 warm in-process generates after one discarded cold generate. Headline is the median of the 6 per-rep medians of per-step complete_wall_ns on decode steps.
definition.cold_first_step: The first step of the first generate in a fresh process is graph-cold (shader/pipeline first-touch). Historically 107.97 ms GPU. It is a prefill step. It is reported and is never averaged into the steady median.
definition.complete_token: one native decode step plus the per-token host work that recurs: host encode/prepare, submit, wait, GPU timestamp/status epilogue, sample readback, position/state update, tokenizer decode of the new id, bookkeeping. Sampling is device argmax inside the same CB.
definition.gpu_definition: MTLCommandBuffer.GPUEndTime - GPUStartTime after wait; never a CPU-wait proxy.
definition.prefill_exclusion: Q80 mixed generate_mixed_greedy definition, applied verbatim. Prefill = teacher-forced walk of every prompt token. The last prefill step emits new-token[0] and is first_token_latency. Steady-state denominator is new-tokens[1..] only (role==decode). Prompt encode, chat render, session.open, and session.reset are request/process-level and are not divided into the per-token wall.
